NOON REPORT - MV TORMAR SPRING
Date/time: 26 Jan 2025 1200 (ship's time UTC)
Position: 50-50.2N 031-32.2W
Distance run last 24h: 231.3 nm
Average speed last 24h: 13.5 kn
ROB VLSFO: 1019.0 t
ROB MGO: 94.5 t
Consumption last 24h: VLSFO 18.8 t, MGO 0.1 t
Next port: Sept-Iles
ETA Sept-Iles: 2025-01-31 1100 UTC
ETA based on: 12.5 kn
Remarks: Main engine stopped 0610-1140 UTC: fuel oil filters choked with sludge stirred up in the heavy weather. Filters cleaned, engine restarted, vessel resumed passage. Average speed over 18.5 h steaming. Fuel used during stoppage: VLSFO 1.1 t (generators and boiler).

Master MV TORMAR SPRING

Dear Master,

Regarding noon report nr-0106 of 26 Jan 2025, please confirm:

1. Main engine stoppage times: 0610–1140 UTC on 26 Jan 2025.
2. Reported figures: distance run 231.3 nm over 18.5 steaming hours at an average speed of 13.5 kn.

Our voyage agent has noted that the stoppage is inconsistent with the distance run and speed: 231.3 nm over 18.5 h at 13.5 kn implies 249.8 nm expected, a 7.4% difference.

No off-hire period will be considered until these figures are confirmed.

Thank you for your cooperation.
